summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting an interim scrip dividend of EUR 400 million payable in cash or shares at shareholder election. The dividend per share will be set on the ex-dividend dates of May 18 (European)/May 19 (US) with a record date of May 19, 2026. Shareholders may elect cash or shares from May 20 through June 2, 2026; failure to elect defaults to shares. The ratio will be based on volume-weighted average price from May 29–June 2, announced June 11. This is a routine capital return, not a special situation.
